Package ch.ahdis.matchbox.validation.matchspark

Class LlmConnector

java.lang.Object
ch.ahdis.matchbox.validation.matchspark.LlmConnector
public class LlmConnector extends Object
The OpenAIConnector class is used to create the http-POST-request to OpenAI. In order to create the request you need to define a model and an API-key (which is stored as an environment variable). Four of the used prompts are displayed here as final strings. Because there were 3 prototypes, a slightly different block of code for the respecting methods. There could be some refactoring done here.

      public static LlmConnector getConnector(MatchboxFhirContextLlmProperties llmProperties, List<dev.langchain4j.model.chat.listener.ChatModelListener> listeners)
      Parameters:
      listeners - the ChatModelListeners to register on the built ChatModel, e.g. the Micrometer/Observation listeners that emit the gen_ai.* metrics. Without this, those listener beans are never invoked and no metrics are recorded.

    • interpretWithMatchbox

      public String interpretWithMatchbox(String resource, String operationOutcome)
      Final Prototype: Interprets the result with a LLM of OpenAI. Uses a function called createRequestBody(). Gets input from GUI.
      Parameters:
      resource - The string received from the Matchbox containing the FHIR resource.
      operationOutcome - The string received from the Matchbox containing the validation result (OperationOutcome).
